_: Eaglercraft's clients for cavekit-eaglercraft.md R1 (T-665): the official downloads of eaglercraft.com (its /downloads page, read 2026-11-18). Not redistributed: they carry Mojang's assets. eaglercraft-fetch.py fetches each into the host cache, checks its size and SHA-256 (recorded at the first fetch), and unpacks it; the device is served from the cache.

hosted_launcher._: Each client's hosted form is this launcher with ?version=<client>: a Next.js page (ads, telemetry, cloud saves, a worker) that fetches the build at run time from cdn.eaglercraft.net/objects/builds/<parent>/<child>/<version>, named by a descriptor it reads then (mirror cdn.eaglercraft.ru). Its own DOWNLOAD_LINKS are the offline zips above, the same URLs. It is no fixed artifact: size and SHA-256 are the page as read on the date. The device round tests the offline builds and tries the launcher once (T-666).
